items.quote: Prorad did an excellent job pressure washing my home. I called and Chris came out within the hour to give me a price and we set up for service the next day. He did an outstanding job! My house and driveway look brand new. He was professional and courteous and I would highly recommend him to my friends and family.
Amazing Job!!! I needed a house clean immediatley. Chris was there the same day and exceeded all of my expectations. He came back the next day "just to check" and felt the roof could be even better.

PRORAD is not the cheapest in town, but we have found time and again, when you go with the cheapest, you get what you pay for. We thought the price was fair for the work put in! If you want a quality job, this is who you need to call!

I am 100% satisfied with PRORAD's pressure washing service! My entire house, driveway/entryway, sidewalks & vinyl fence look pristine! Chris was very professional, kind, humble and hard working. He worked on my house for hours!

Chris came to our house in Kissimmee while me and my wife was away for work. Pressure washed the entire house as well as the back porch and front over hang. Done an amazing job and comes highly recommended.
